title: En Buckingham Palace
setting: Vas con Emma, tus nietos y el hijo de tu vecina a ver el cambio de guardia

says.t: Look at the guards! Their hats are so tall!

options.t: Wow! Kids, look at their hats!
Wow! Kids, look at there hats!
options.feedback: «Sus» (de ellos) se escribe their; there es «allí».

options.es: No, es el hijo de mi vecina.

options.feedback: Falta la 's: my neighbour's son (el hijo de mi vecina).

options.t: No, he's the son of my neighbour's.
options.es: (No, es el hijo de de mi vecina.)
options.feedback: O una cosa o la otra. Lo natural: my neighbour's son.

says.t: He's lovely. Has he got a camera?

options.t: Yes, he has. It's his dad's camera.
options.es: Sí. Es la cámara de su padre.

says.t: Look! The king's flag is on the palace.
says.es: ¡Mira! La bandera del rey está en el palacio.

options.t: So the king is at home today!
options.es: ¡Entonces el rey está hoy en casa!

options.t: So the king has at home today!
options.feedback: Estar en un sitio = to be: the king is at home.

options.t: Yes, they are. They're very hungry!

options.feedback: Tener hambre = to be hungry: Yes, they are.

says.t: I've got sandwiches in my bag!

options.t: Thank you, Emma! You're very kind.
Thank you, Emma! Your very kind.
